lowest_axis: freshness (historically lowest; no invented numeric rerating; the uncalibrated numeric rubric remains a named conformance debt)

claims.before: Twenty unresolved source rows in thirteen assigned supplemental ledgers; zero round-5 follow-up rows at the pinned baseline.
claims.after_required: At least ten distinct original unresolved rows rechecked; at least three newly retrieved directly relevant passages with source locators, short excerpts and explicit inference limits. Parent independently re-fetches at least three passages before admission. Preserve supported/contradicted/unresolved scope; unsuccessful retrieval is not factual confirmation.
claims.counting_command: python3 reports/round-5/run-validation.py (parent acceptance runner, to be implemented only after actual dispatch)
claims.no_harm: No old ledger changes, marker-clearing metric, fabricated source or canon decisions; append corpus errata only when source evidence warrants them. Distinguish metadata checks, retrieved passages and unread works.

before.craft_selftest: exit 0; SELFTEST OK 10/10 tamper cases detected

claims.after_required: New standalone battery runs all seven original gate selftests in an isolated copied tree and demonstrates stable positive/negative controls with original gate/fixture bytes unchanged. All six named malformed craft CLI/input cases return 2 with stable diagnostics and no traceback. Existing positive craft run, --counts, optional existing-report read and ten mutation detections remain valid. Both historical round-3 replay manifests still reproduce 7/7 and all previous acceptance assertions remain green.
claims.no_harm: Do not change tools/gates/*.py, historical frozen bytes, toy sound laws, source semantics or D2 packet contents. A safe wrapper is not a retrospective claim that the five legacy selftests themselves stopped writing fixtures.

source_assignment_rule: Ten disjoint two-row follow-up ledgers cover the twenty unresolved supplemental IDs; workers own only their new ledger, never the common corpus entries or historical ledgers.
scope: Child repo only. Workers never commit, spawn, edit shared bookkeeping, provider configuration, credentials, siblings, fleet state or canon. Parent owns integration, append-only LOG, SCORECARD, SKILL registry, lesson, acceptance, lane report after work commit and own-origin push.
availability_rule: Native exact-model dispatch only. If route validation rejects before launch, persist refusal and prepared request; no substitution, custom client, manual execution of worker tasks or claim of completed round. The overall goal's consecutive-turn blocker audit still applies.
